lit: Even monkeys fall from trees.
en: Everyone makes mistakes.

lit: Fall down seven times, get up eight.
en: Never give up.

say: ishi no ue ni mo san-nen
lit: Three years even on a (cold) stone.
en: Perseverance wins in the end.

lit: Dumplings over flowers.
en: Substance over style / practical over pretty.

lit: One time, one meeting.
en: Treasure every encounter — it will never happen the same way again.

lit: Ten people, ten colors.
en: To each their own.

ja: 塵も積もれば山となる
say: chiri mo tsumoreba yama to naru
lit: Even dust, piled up, becomes a mountain.
en: Every little bit adds up.

lit: If you're in a hurry, go around.
en: More haste, less speed.

lit: The nail that sticks out gets hammered down.
en: Standing out invites criticism.

lit: Not knowing is Buddha.
en: Ignorance is bliss.

say: nō aru taka wa tsume o kakusu
lit: The talented hawk hides its claws.
en: Truly skilled people don't show off.

ja: 井の中の蛙大海を知らず
say: i no naka no kawazu taikai o shirazu
lit: A frog in a well doesn't know the great ocean.
en: Don't be narrow-minded — there's a big world out there.

ja: 二兎を追う者は一兎をも得ず
say: nito o ou mono wa itto o mo ezu
lit: Chase two rabbits and you won't catch even one.
en: Focus on one thing at a time.

lit: After the rain, the ground hardens.
en: Things get stronger after a hard time.

ja: 郷に入っては郷に従え
say: gō ni itte wa gō ni shitagae
lit: When you enter a village, follow the village.
en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

lit: Hearing a hundred times is not as good as seeing once.
en: Seeing is believing.

say: warau kado ni wa fuku kitaru
lit: Fortune comes to the gate of those who laugh.
en: Happiness comes to those who smile.

lit: Time is money.
en: Time is money.

lit: The mouth is the source of disaster.
en: Careless words cause trouble.

lit: Good medicine tastes bitter.
en: Honest advice is hard to hear.

lit: Continuing is strength.
en: Keep at it — consistency is power.

ja: 案ずるより産むが易し
lit: Giving birth is easier than worrying about it.
en: It's easier than you fear — just do it.
